notes: Mathematical target: classify when one cyclic/nondegenerate raising pairing can simultaneously generate the temporal gravity-clock, typed Maxwell, switched emitter Hessian, and temporal emitter-Diff Ward orbits from one action.

Candidate theorem: in the frozen component-preserving pairing family the three scale equations form a full-rank compatibility matrix, so no nonzero common raising pairing exists; any repair must change a declared action normalization, admit a symmetry-compatible off-diagonal pairing block, or enlarge the dual carrier.

Proof obligations: derive the three scale equations without importing the certificate verdict; prove invariance of rank under admissible field rescalings and action-equivalent presentation changes; define a complete bounded minimal-extension family; classify its solution locus; regenerate q1/q2 from one action for every surviving class.

Counterexample strategy: the factor-two mutation must restore the known null vector (1,1,1); dropping any Ward orbit must expose which compatibility equation was decisive; a proposed repair that fails the original tau_star witness is rejected.
Certificate boundary: this ticket is LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC/REDUCED-MODE only. It does not establish q3 closure, detector response, causality, a physical branch, particles, or quantum consistency.
